questions.stem: A whiteboard, which is \(1.2\text{ m}\) wide, is to be placed in the exact centre of a classroom wall. The total length of the wall from left to right is \(6\text{ m}\). What is the distance from the left-hand edge of the wall to the left-hand edge of the whiteboard?

Step-by-step breakdown:

Step 1: Convert all measurements to the same unit (metres):
Wall length \(= 6\text{ m}\)
Whiteboard width \(= 1.2\text{ m}\).

Step 2: Find the total leftover space on the wall by subtracting the whiteboard width from the total wall length:
\(\text{Leftover space} = 6\text{ m} - 1.2\text{ m} = 4.8\text{ m}\).

Step 3: Since the whiteboard is centered, this leftover space is divided equally between the left and right sides:
\(\text{Left side distance} = \frac{4.8\text{ m}}{2} = 2.4\text{ m}\).

\(\text{Total markers} = 40 + 1 = 41\).

questions.stem: Calculate the time elapsed between \(8\text{ p.m.}\) on Monday and \(7:35\text{ a.m.}\) on Wednesday.

Step 1: Count the time from Monday 8 p.m. to Tuesday 8 p.m.:
This is exactly \(24\text{ hours}\).

Step 2: Count the time from Tuesday 8 p.m. to Wednesday 8 a.m. (the next morning):
This is exactly \(12\text{ hours}\).
Accumulated total \(= 24 + 12 = 36\text{ hours}\) (representing Wednesday 8:00 a.m.).

Step 3: Since the end time is 7:35 a.m., which is \(25\text{ minutes}\) before 8:00 a.m., we subtract \(25\text{ minutes}\) from \(36\text{ hours}\):
\(36\text{ hours} - 25\text{ minutes} = 35\text{ hours and } 35\text{ minutes}\).

questions.stem: Calculate the difference between two finish times for a race: \(02:28:15\) and \(03:42:38\).
questions.solution:

Therefore, the time difference is \(1\text{ hour, } 14\text{ minutes, and } 23\text{ seconds}\).

questions.stem: Calculate the time elapsed between \(9:15\text{ a.m.}\) and \(4:12\text{ p.m.}\) on the same day.

\(9:15\text{ a.m.} \rightarrow 09:15\)
\(4:12\text{ p.m.} \rightarrow 16:12\)

Step 2: Subtract the start time from the end time:
\(16:12 - 09:15\)

Since 12 minutes is less than 15 minutes, borrow 1 hour (60 minutes) from 16:
\(16:12 = 15:72\)
\(15:72 - 09:15 = 6\text{ hours and } 57\text{ minutes}\).

Step 3: Go back \(8\text{ minutes}\) from Monday 10:00 a.m.:
\(10:00\text{ a.m.} - 8\text{ minutes} =\) Monday 9:52 a.m..
